items.title: Lightweight
items.text: A simpler Stremio Origin: one clean black and gold look, the tabs in the middle of the top bar, and a short list of settings.

items.title: Set up for you
items.text: Subtitles in sync, white and easy to read, sources cleaned, the best match first: all on from the start, nothing to adjust.

items.title: Downloads
items.text: With a USB drive in the TV, the yellow key on a stream keeps the film or episode on it. Its size and the drive's room are checked first.

items.title: The TV's keyboard in Search
items.text: Go up to the search bar and press OK to type with the TV's own keyboard.
